newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada wholesale trade rises 0.4 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Canada wholesale trade rises 0.4 pct in September.

text.p: Canada's wholesale trade rose 0.4 percent seasonally adjusted in September to C$21.52 billion, Statistics Canada said on Friday.
Sales, adj C$21.52 bln 0.4 pct 5.3 pct
Inventories, adj C$31.61 bln 0.4 pct 0.5 pct
Note - dollar figures are billions. Other figures are percentage changes.
A Reuter survey of economists had forecast a 0.9 percent month-on-month rise in September.
StatsCan also revised its figure for August sales to C$21.42 billion from C$21.44 billion.
The government agency said seven of the 11 trade groups posted higher sales in September, accounting for about 66 percent of total sales.
The highest increases in wholesale sales came from motor vehicles, parts and accessories, and computers, packaged software and other electronic machinery groups.
The two trade groups which experienced the largest declines in wholesale sales in the month were the "other products" and lumber and building materials groups.
In September wholesalers increased their inventories for the second month in a row by 0.4 percent to C$36.1 billion.
